n04-luis-gets-dressed.observed_description: Luis, barefoot in khaki chinos by an open wardrobe in a white bedroom with a navy duvet and folded grey pajamas, crosses both arms to grip the hem of his navy T-shirt, which is rolled up above his bare stomach, looking down. Identity, room and 4:5 crop are fine.
n04-luis-gets-dressed.rejection: The crossed-arm grip on a lifted hem is the conventional pose for taking a T-shirt OFF, so the picture does not show 'gets dressed' unambiguously and would collide with 'take off' in Lesson 1.4.

n01-luis-wakes-up.observed_description: Luis, in a heather-grey T-shirt, sits up in bed under a navy duvet with both arms stretched up and a sleepy smile, eyes nearly closed; white walls, window and curtains at left, oak nightstand and lamp. Top-right corner is plain wall for the clock. Reads as waking up at 180 px; the 4:5 crop trims part of one raised fist without losing the meaning.

n02-luis-brushes-his-teeth.observed_description: Luis, in a grey T-shirt and dark pajama pants, brushes his teeth with a blue toothbrush (white foam at his lips) at a white sink, left hand on the basin, three-quarter view; towel on a rail, plant on a shelf, no mirror. Natural five-finger hands; clear at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.

n03-ana-brushes-her-teeth.observed_description: Ana, in light-blue button-up pajamas with long dark wavy hair, brushes her teeth with a pink toothbrush (foam at her lips) at a white sink with a brass faucet and cream tiles, green towels; only the edge of a wall cabinet at far left, no reflection of her. Natural hands; reads at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.

n06-ana-eats-breakfast.observed_description: Ana, in her sage overshirt over a white top, sits at a light-wood kitchen table by a bright window and lifts a spoon of cereal to her mouth; a white bowl of cereal, two slices of toast, a glass of orange juice and a white coffee mug in front of her; her brown tote hangs on a chair. Unmistakable breakfast at 180 px and in the 4:5 crop.
